videoSource.title: Video Source (e.g. /dev/video0)
videoSource.description: Full ffmpeg input arguments for your camera.

fingerprint.title: Camera Fingerprint (leave blank to generate automatically)
fingerprint.description: If left blank, a fingerprint will be generated and saved on first run.

debugLogging.title: Enable Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Print detailed logs for troubleshooting. Leave off under normal operation.

rebroadcastEnabled.title: [EXPERIMENTAL] Enable Video Rebroadcasting
rebroadcastEnabled.description: Plugin exclusively owns the camera and exposes an MJPEG stream + snapshot URL for other plugins.

maxFrameAgeMs.title: Max Frame Age for Upload (ms)
maxFrameAgeMs.description: If the latest frame is older than this, the plugin skips uploading that cycle.

rebroadcastStreamUrl.title: Stream URL (copy to Camera FFmpeg → source)
rebroadcastStreamUrl.description: If you change the port, update the URL accordingly.

rebroadcastSnapshotUrl.title: Snapshot URL (copy to Camera FFmpeg → stillImageSource)
rebroadcastSnapshotUrl.description: If you change the port, update the URL accordingly.
